events.text: For the July 25, 2025 snapshot, inspect the entire Wayfinding Checklist and count only actual control records (not headings, guidance, or other non-control rows). Return total controls, Complete count, incomplete count (all statuses other than Complete), completion rate, number of incomplete Critical-priority controls, and every control marked Blocked with control ID and affected relocated service. Identify the status field exactly as recorded and clarify how you treated any other non-complete statuses.

response.text:
## July 25, 2025 snapshot

Counted **45 actual control records** (WF-001–WF-045), excluding headings and guidance rows.

| Measure | Result |
|---|---:|
| Total controls | 45 |
| Complete | 22 |
| Incomplete (any status other than Complete) | 23 |
| Completion rate | **48.9%** (22 ÷ 45) |
| Incomplete Critical-priority controls | 10 |

The status field’s exact header is **`Status`**. Its recorded values are **Complete**, **In Progress**, **Not Started**, and **Blocked**. I counted **In Progress**, **Not Started**, and **Blocked** as incomplete. The 23 incomplete controls comprise 14 In Progress, 6 Not Started, and 3 Blocked.

### Blocked controls

| Control ID | Affected relocated service |
|---|---|
| WF-028 | Endoscopy |
| WF-032 | Pulmonary |
| WF-036 | General Surgery |
